items.source: Note: if the underlying WebSocket API does not provide flow control for receiving messages, this method should be a no-op and canSuspendReceiving() should return false.
items.translation: 注意： 如果底层的 WebSocket API 不提供接收消息的流量控制，此方法应为空操作，且canSuspendReceiving()应返回false。

items.source: Also implements Subscriber<Void> so it can be used to subscribe to the completion of WebSocketHandler.handle(WebSocketSession).
items.translation: 还实现了 `Subscriber<Void>`，因此可用于订阅WebSocketHandler.handle(WebSocketSession)的完成。

items.source: This stream receives a completion or error signal when the connection is closed. In a typical WebSocketHandler implementation this stream is composed into the overall processing flow, so that when the connection is closed, handling will end.
items.translation: 该流在连接关闭时接收完成或错误信号。在典型的 WebSocketHandler 实现中，此流被组合到整体处理流程中，以便在连接关闭时结束处理。

items.source: See the class-level doc of WebSocketHandler and the reference for more details and examples of how to handle the session.
items.translation: 参见 WebSocketHandler 的类级别文档和参考，以获取更多有关如何处理会话的详细信息和示例。

items.source: Primarily for use with WebSocketClient to be able to communicate the end of handling.
items.translation: 主要用于与WebSocketClient配合使用，以便能够通知处理结束。

items.source: Note: Sub-classes are encouraged to start out in suspended mode, if possible, and wait until demand is received.
items.translation: 注意： 如果可能，建议子类以挂起模式启动，并等待收到需求。

items.source: Note: Sub-classes are responsible for releasing the payload data buffer, once fully written, if pooled buffers apply to the underlying container.
items.translation: 注意： 如果底层容器适用缓冲池，则在完全写入后，子类负责释放负载数据缓冲区。
